Author: Yodhrin13
Name: HousingMarketShopper
Punchline: Automatically source and buy housing furnishings at the best cross-world price.
Description: Reads a MakePlace furnishing list, finds the cheapest market listings across all worlds via Universalis, then automates world-hopping and purchasing via Lifestream.
Changelog:
1.0.3
- New: manual + persistent item resolution — Fix unresolved/fuzzy items via a searchable picker; corrections are remembered across imports
- New: save, load, and delete named shopping lists
- New: resume an interrupted run after a crash or logout (progress saved to disk)
- New: dry-run mode logs the full route and intended purchases without buying
- New: budget cap drops the most expensive items to keep a plan under a gil ceiling
- New: gil-on-hand check warns when a plan exceeds your current gil
- New: per-item world-price comparison popup and an Open on Universalis link
- New: plan sort/filter, consolidation savings, and a rough travel-time estimate
- New: confirm dialog shows the expected source world and listings/retainers
- New: configurable price-premium tolerance and stale-listing threshold
- New: inline quantity editing and resolution confidence in the Import tab
